lessons.name: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
lessons.desc: Measures load performance of the largest image or text block. Target: < 2.5s. Key causes: slow server, render-blocking resources, slow resource load, client-side rendering.

lessons.name: Interaction to Next Paint (INP)
lessons.desc: Measures responsiveness — time from user interaction to next visual update. Target: < 200ms. Replaced FID in 2024.

lessons.name: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
lessons.desc: Measures visual stability — unexpected layout shifts during page load. Target: < 0.1. Causes: images without dimensions, injected content, font swap.

lessons.name: First Contentful Paint (FCP)
lessons.desc: First pixel of content painted. Target: < 1.8s. Leading indicator for LCP. Affected by TTFB and render-blocking resources.

lessons.name: Time to First Byte (TTFB)
lessons.desc: Server response time. Target: < 800ms. Affected by server processing, CDN, database queries. Foundation for all other metrics.

lessons.name: Measuring with DevTools & CrUX
lessons.desc: Chrome DevTools Performance panel, Lighthouse, PageSpeed Insights, Web Vitals extension, CrUX dashboard, RUM via web-vitals.js

lessons.name: React Rendering Mental Model
lessons.desc: When does React re-render? State change, parent re-render, context change. What triggers a reconciliation vs a full re-mount.

lessons.name: React.memo & Bailout
lessons.desc: memo() wraps a component to skip re-render if props are referentially equal. When it helps, when it hurts, when it's unnecessary.

lessons.name: useMemo & useCallback
lessons.desc: Memoize expensive values (useMemo) and stable function references (useCallback). The real cost: memory + comparison overhead.

lessons.name: React DevTools Profiler
lessons.desc: Flame chart, ranked chart, why-did-this-render, interaction timing. Finding unnecessary re-renders in production.

lessons.name: Virtualization / Windowing
lessons.desc: react-window, react-virtual (TanStack) — render only visible rows. Critical for lists > 100 items.

lessons.name: useTransition & startTransition
lessons.desc: Mark state updates as non-urgent. The UI stays responsive during heavy re-renders. Concurrent rendering in practice.

lessons.name: Bundle Analysis
lessons.desc: webpack-bundle-analyzer, Vite bundle visualizer, rollup-plugin-visualizer. Reading treemaps. Finding duplicates and dead code.

lessons.name: Code Splitting & Lazy Loading
lessons.desc: Dynamic import(), React.lazy + Suspense, route-based splitting, component-level splitting, interaction-based loading

lessons.name: Tree Shaking
lessons.desc: ESM static imports enable tree shaking. Named imports, barrel file pitfalls, sideEffects flag in package.json, dead code elimination.

lessons.name: Compression & Encoding
lessons.desc: Gzip vs Brotli (Brotli is 15-25% smaller). Static pre-compression vs on-the-fly. AVIF/WebP for images. woff2 for fonts.

lessons.name: HTTP/2 & Resource Hints
lessons.desc: Multiplexing, header compression, server push (deprecated). preload, prefetch, preconnect, dns-prefetch — when each applies.

lessons.name: Caching Strategy
lessons.desc: Cache-Control headers, immutable assets, stale-while-revalidate, service worker caching, content-addressable filenames

lessons.name: Modern Image Formats
lessons.desc: AVIF vs WebP vs JPEG — size comparison, browser support, <picture> with fallbacks, quality vs size tradeoffs

lessons.name: Responsive Images
lessons.desc: srcset with w descriptors, sizes attribute, art direction with <picture>, DPR (devicePixelRatio) optimization

lessons.name: Lazy Loading & Decoding
lessons.desc: loading="lazy", loading="eager", decoding="async", Intersection Observer for custom lazy loading, LCP element must NOT be lazy

lessons.name: Critical CSS & Render-blocking
lessons.desc: Inline above-the-fold CSS, defer non-critical CSS, remove unused CSS, PurgeCSS, critical npm package

lessons.name: Font Performance
lessons.desc: font-display: swap/optional/block, subsetting, preloading, FOUT vs FOIT vs FOFT, variable fonts

lessons.name: Video & Animation Performance
lessons.desc: <video> vs GIF (always prefer video), preload="none" for below-fold video, will-change, compositor layers, CSS transforms over position

lessons.name: Performance Budgets
lessons.desc: Setting limits: max JS bundle size, max LCP, max CLS. Failing the build if budgets are exceeded. Lighthouse CI thresholds.

lessons.name: Lighthouse CI
lessons.desc: Automated Lighthouse in CI/CD. GitHub Actions integration, assertions, score thresholds, PR comments with scores.

lessons.name: Service Workers & Offline
lessons.desc: Cache-first, network-first, stale-while-revalidate strategies. Workbox. Offline fallback pages. Background sync.

lessons.name: Prerendering & Hydration Optimization
lessons.desc: Selective hydration, islands architecture, resumability (Qwik). Reducing TBT by deferring hydration of below-fold components.

lessons.name: Third-party Script Impact
lessons.desc: Measuring third-party script cost. Tag Manager audit. Lazy loading analytics. Facade patterns for embeds (YouTube, maps).

lessons.name: Performance Culture & Dashboards
lessons.desc: Sharing perf wins with the team. Automated regression detection. Grafana dashboards for RUM. Performance as a KPI.
